text:
anya: quick update from the magnet-32k-int4 bring-up: seeing RoPE phase drift after ~48k tokens when running quantized model w/ kv-cache enabled. small reproducer attached below.

sam: ugh, is it a soft drift (gradual) or a sharp wrap/offset?

anya: looks like soft accumulated phase error for ~48k-52k range, then a set of tokens are returned shifted by 1-3 positions. not catastrophic but triggers inference divergence checks. reproducer output: 

anya: ```
# run with: ./tests/longctx_repro --model magnet-32k-int4 --seed 42 --length 56000 --kv-cache on --quant hybrid
...
STEP 48005: prefix_tokens=48000 current_pos=48005 token_out=..
Mismatch: golden[48012] != model_out[48009]
KV fingerprint: shard0:0x7f8a3b2c shard1:0x7f8a3b2d
```

matt: hmm, hybrid quant + continuous batching + RoPE scaling could interact. did you run float32 baseline?

anya: yes, float baseline (no quant) stays synced to 56k. int4-hybrid starts diverging ~48k consistently.

liz: what's the rotary implementation? are we using legacy freq scale or the new ropex_rescale?

anya: using legacy scaling for this build. i tried flipping ropex_rescale=true locally and the drift window moved to ~53k but still shows a phase offset at wrap boundaries.

sam: can you dump KV indices around the fault? maybe an off-by-one when we compact or when shard join occurs.

anya: posted snippet of KV index dump: ```
-- kv_index_dump @ 48000 --
shard0.entries: [47990..48005]
shard1.entries: [48006..48020]
-- expected contiguous, found gap at boundary: 48005->48006 but fingerprint mismatch
```

matt: that boundary gap flags the prefill->inflight handshake. I remember a recent perf patch that changed prefill stride to 16 (was 8). Could be aliasing with rotary period.

sam: possibility: quant packing changed alignment, memcopy uses 64B vs 32B and rotation math assumes contiguous token offsets -> leads to phase misalignment. can you repro with `--no-prefetch` and `--prefill-stride=8`?

anya: tried `--prefill-stride=8` and `--no-prefetch`. drift delayed but still occurs at ~54k. attaching minimal repro logs in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/rotary-drift-1759992460

liz: measurement: compared token-level perplexity divergence between float & int4 across longprefill bench. numbers: float baseline ppx=1.02, int4-hybrid ppx=1.05 up to 48k, then int4 ppx rises to 1.22 at 56k. so quality reg worsens with drift.

matt: can we toggle `ropex_phase_clamp`? last time clamp prevented wrap runaway in int8. also consider reordering shard merges so rotary phase offsets use absolute token positions not relative per-shard.

anya: tried `ropex_phase_clamp=0.999` — helps slightly. I also dumped kv keys before/after shard swap and noticed the `pos_scale` field changed sign for some keys after compaction — suspicious.

sam: @anya can you create a short bisect script to run between commit a3f8 and a4d1 (prefill-stride change)? I can run on CI overnight.

infra-bot: scheduled nightly-run job longctx-bisect-1759992460 on cluster-3, ETA 6h.

matt: thanks infra-bot :thumbsup: If bisect pins it to the stride change we should consider a quick fix: make rotary use global token counter for phase idx and ignore compacted index offsets. small patch i can sketch.

anya: creating issue with attachments and sample seeds. adding labels: long-context, kv-cache, rot-phase, quant. Will post PR once bisect completes.

liz: also recommend adding a regression test that runs a 64k synthetic prefix compare float vs quant every release. it catches these slow drift modes.

sam: agreed. i'll add a CI hack to run lightweight 64k smoke on nightly for impacted models.

anya: thanks all — will follow up with bisect output & a short repro script. if anyone wants the raw dumps dm me.

matt: ping me after the bisect, i'll draft the rotary absolute-phase patch.

anya: noted, thanks :heart:
